description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system within an Android project. It specifies a contract for log output components, indicating how log entries should be processed and chained together.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging component that can output log information and be chained to other log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log entry, passing log level, tag, message, and optionally an exception (Throwable).
